FINDINGS: There is no acute intracranial haemorrhage, no extra-axial collection and no mass effect. The ventricles and basal cisterns are normal in size and configuration. IMPRESSION: 1. No acute intracranial abnormality. 2. Right parietal scalp haematoma, no fracture. 3. Chronic sinus mucosal thickening.
